dct_creator_sm: Ross, Sue (University of Alberta). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0600-4833
dct_description_sm: The objective of this Canadian multi-centre pragmatic randomized controlled trial was to compare the effectiveness of the new single-incision device, Gynecare TVT Secur, to the established predecate retropubic TVT device, in terms of objective cure of stress urinary incontinence (SUI) at 12 months postoperatively. Other outcomes included: complications, symptoms, and incontinence-related quality of life.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_spatial_sm: Calgary, Alberta; Edmonton, Alberta; Vancouver, British Columbia; Penticton, British Columbia
dct_title_s: Single Incision Device (TVT Secur) Versus Retropubic Tension-free Vaginal Tape Device (TVT) for the Management of Stress Urinary Incontinence in Women: A Randomized Clinical Trial
pcdm_memberOf_sm: Women and Children's Health Research Institute (WCHRI)
